post.summary: Answer a question from the project's documents
post.description: Finds the indexed chunks that best match the question and has a language model answer from them, citing each source as [n]. Signal `no_answer`, with `answer` null, means the documents do not answer the question. With `conversation_id`, the question is a follow-up: it is first rewritten into a standalone question from the conversation so far, and the question and the answer are added to the conversation.

post.description: The same answer as POST /api/v1/ask/{project_id}, as Server-Sent Events: `delta` events carry the next piece of text (`{"text": ...}`), then one `answer` event carries the full response, with its citations. A `no_answer` reply sends no `delta` events. If the model fails mid-answer, an `error` event (`{"signal": "llm_failed"}`) ends the stream. Errors before the stream starts are returned as usual.
